messages.text: I placed an order in Batch 5 and would like to ask about the delivery status.
Happy to check that for you. What's your order number (it looks like Shop····)? Also send me one detail from the order so I can match it: the name it ships to, the postcode, or the email you used.

I found your order, Torsten. Your Magic M. 40T is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It was due to ship November 14, so it's late, and I'm sorry we didn't write to you about the delay.

The units have left the factory and are on their way to our warehouses. I don't have a confirmed new ship date for yours yet, so I've asked the team to confirm it. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you. You'll also get tracking by email as soon as your miner ships.

You can follow the shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
OK, I understand—but why does the webpage still show November 14th as the ship date?

You're right, that date is out of date. November 14 is the date your batch showed when you ordered, and it hasn't been updated to reflect the delay. I'm sorry for the confusion. The units are on their way to our warehouses now, but your miner won't ship on November 14.

The team will confirm your new ship date by email, and you'll get tracking as soon as it ships. Can I help with anything else?
Ok i stay tuned!

Before you go, one thing: what made you pick the Magic M. 40T over our other miners?
Ask me if i have the Miner!
Fair enough, I'll ask once it's running on your desk. Thanks, Torsten. The team will email you the new ship date, and tracking will follow as soon as your miner ships.
Thank you and bye
You're welcome, Torsten. Have a good evening, and I hope your 40T is with you soon.
